messages.content: pricing kivabe thik korbo bujhtechi na, khub kom rakhle loss naki?
Loss na, but undervalue korle পরে বাড়াতে গেলে existing subscriber der resistance আসে। Competitor der pricing দেখেছো kichu?
Tahole oi range e shuru kora reasonable, moderate side e - beshi kom na abar beshi high o na jate initial subscriber paoa easy hoy. Ekhon tomar range e kothay bhabcho?
Sounds fair, oita diye 2-3 mash try koro then data dekhe adjust koro - churn rate ar conversion dekhle bujhba beshi na kom.
